text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — I pulled a quick audit and ~86 trial accounts are stuck on the 'Integration' milestone for >14 days. A few are approaching renewal and we don't have owners assigned. Can we add a quick safety play to reassign or ping Eng when integrations stall? :thinking:

ajay_csops: ack. can you paste the query you used? thinking we should avoid mass reassigning — maybe nudge + escalate if unresponsive for 7 days after nudge. :+1:

maria_cs: sure — ran this in the CRM sandbox:```
SELECT account_id, created_at, milestone, owner_id FROM account_stage_history
WHERE milestone = 'Integration' AND last_updated < now() - interval '14 days'
AND lifecycle_stage = 'trial';
```

maria_cs: results include a bunch of partner integrations and a handful of orphaned accounts (owner_id NULL).

sam_eng: wild — we can add a small automation in the ops queue: when milestone=Integration and owner_id IS NULL, create a task and assign to cs-rotation or set owner to 'unassigned-cs' tag. then trigger a webhook to the onboarding playbook service that pings the onboarding checklist.

ajay_csops: prefer not to auto-assign humans. proposal: (1) auto-create a short-lived task assigned to cs-queue, (2) send a batched email/nudge to the account's contact + owner if present, (3) after 7 days escalate to AMs and add renewal-risk tag.

jin_prod: we should also surface this in Console healthscore so Product Ops can see a spike. Suggest adding a derived metric: integration_blocked_days and a threshold alert if >50 accounts. I can add a lightweight eval that maps "Integration stuck" to a healthscore penalty (-10).

maria_cs: that works. Ajay — can you draft the nudge message? keep it short, link to integration checklist, and include quick-reply buttons. We can use the playbook automation to send 2 nudges 3 days apart before escalation.

ajay_csops: draft below, feel free to edit:
"Hi {{contact_first_name}} — we noticed setup for {{account_name}} is paused at the Integration step. If you'd like help, click 'Request help' or reply here and we'll reconnect you with onboarding. If setup is complete, mark the step done: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/{{account_id}}. Thanks!"

maria_cs: perfect. can we make the 'Request help' button open a short form that creates a ticket in zendesk and adds a tag 'integration-help'?

sam_eng: yep — webhook payload can include account_id, contact_email, and a small context object. sample payload:```
{
  "account_id": "{{account_id}}",
  "contact": "{{contact_email}}",
  "reason": "integration_stalled"
}
```

ops_bot: Automation created: cs/integration-stall/nudge-v1 (status: draft) — scheduled to run on matching records.

maria_cs: next steps: Ajay to finalize nudge copy + escalation window (today), Sam to add webhook endpoint and task creation (EOD), Jin to add healthscore penalty and alert (this week). I'll run a manual orphan-owner backfill for the current 86 accounts and post results here. :raised_hands:

ajay_csops: on it. will post the final copy in this thread when done.

sam_eng: starting webhook PR now, will tag reviewers.

jin_prod: adding healthscore tweak to the backlog and will fast-track the alert.

maria_cs: thanks team — will follow up with a short retrospective next week after the first run.
